indicator_name: CPI by group, COICOP division, item and region, previous month = 100
description: ИПЦ по группам, разделам КООЛИЦ, товарам и услугам и по регионам, к предыдущему месяцу
methodology: BNS Т-15-02-М and predecessors, 2004-07 onward (items and regions); core inflation baskets from 2022-10 (the scalar CORE_CPI_* carry the Taldau history from 2023). Equal to the scalar CPI, CPI_FOOD, CPI_NONFOOD, CPI_SERVICES and CORE_CPI_* on every common month (2011-2026; one 0.1 difference, CPI_FOOD_YOY 2022-06).
